newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Magnetics develops imaging product.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Magnetics develops imaging product.

text.p: Advanced Magnetics Inc said it developed and Mallinckrodt Inc will market GastroMARK, a contrast agent for use with magnetic resonance imaging of the gastrointestinal tract.

It said the product, the first superparamagnetic oral magnetic resonance imaging agent to be marketed in the United States, is designed to be used to mark the bowel and distinguish it from adjacent abdominal structures in upper regions of the gastrointestinal tract.
GastroMARK also has been cleared for marketing in western Europe under the brand name Lumirem.
